about: v1-e32-t11's analytic-text readings of the synthetic caselist, written by hand (README, 'Analytic texts'). Every text is invented. 'words' is what a reading was made from, and its digest is computed from it when the fixture is read; 'quoted' is what reading the source again returns, or null when it could not be read again as it was read; an overview has neither.
